description: This file implements WiFi network scanning functionalities for the WifiManager component, including event registration, asynchronous SSID retrieval, filtering of scan results, and event handling via IARM bus communication.

classes.name: WifiManagerScan
classes.description: Class handling WiFi scan operations, event registration, and processing scan results with filtering capabilities.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Registers event handlers for WiFi SSID availability events.

methods.name: Deinitialize
methods.description: Unregisters event handlers for WiFi SSID availability events.

methods.name: startScan
methods.description: Initiates an asynchronous WiFi scan, optionally filtering by SSID and frequency, and supports incremental results.

methods.name: getAvailableSSIDsAsync
methods.description: Requests the list of available SSIDs asynchronously via IARM bus.

methods.name: getAvailableSSIDsAsyncIncr
methods.description: Requests incremental SSID list updates in stages via IARM bus.

methods.name: iarmEventHandler
methods.description: Handles WiFi SSID list events received from IARM bus, parses JSON data, applies filters, and forwards results.

methods.name: applyFilter
methods.description: Filters SSID list based on regex match for SSID and frequency.
